title: Import native memories
description: Bring selected memories from Codex or Claude Code into MemoSync. Review each item before importing.
modelConsent: Off by default. When enabled, previewing a source sends its locally screened text to your configured memory model. Screening can miss sensitive information. Local extraction keeps source text on this device.
policy: This is a one-way import. Native memory settings stay as they are, so native engines may continue saving their own memories. Rules and skills are listed separately and cannot be imported here.
noSources: No native memory sources found in these locations. Choose another available location and search again.
discoveryTruncated: The search reached its limit. The list may not include every source.
noHistory: Your previews and imports will appear here. Reopen an import to view its receipt or undo it.
chooseSource: Find a source, then select it to preview the memories. A preview does not activate any memories.
originalsKept: Original files are kept. Only checked items will be imported; unchecked items are left for another time.
sourceBlocked: This source cannot be imported. Sensitive sources and independent rules or skills are excluded.
noItems: No importable memories were extracted from this source.
needsReview: Conflict · review the existing memory first
rejectItem: Do not suggest this memory again
rejectionSelected: Will reject this memory · undo selection
rejectNotice: Explicit rejections prevent this claim from being suggested again in its scope. Undo import only archives newly created memories; it does not remove rejections.
savedReceipt: Imported: {{created}} new, {{linked}} linked to existing. Rejected: {{rejected}}.
rollbackReceipt: Undone: {{count}} memories created by this import were archived. Existing memories and original files were kept.
loadFailed: Could not load import sources and history. Try again.
actionFailed: Could not confirm the operation. Refresh history before retrying.
